newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Suharto to visit Jordan, Italy.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Suharto to visit Jordan, Italy.

text.p: Indonesia's President Suharto will visit Jordan and Italy during a week-long trip starting next Monday, State Secretary Murdiono said on Thursday.
"The president will visit Jordan from November 11-14 and will have talks with Jordan King Hussein to strengten relations between the two countries," Murdiono told reporters
He said Suharto would then go on to Rome for the summit of the U.N. Food and Agricultural Organisation (FAO).
Murdiono said that while in Italy, Suharto would meet Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, Indian Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda and Iranian Vice-President Hassan Habibi.
He said Suharto was also scheduled to meet Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro.
Suharto is scheduled to return to Indonesia on November 17.
